title: 第11章 深入合作
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
所谓隔行如隔山，王子真不是搞造船的，网络上和同为爱好者级别的人打嘴炮还是可以的，但还动真格的就不行了，必须找专业的人啊！但是找专业人士也不好找，就现在德国这疙瘩的造舰水平，凯撒出来之前那是没法提的。你就算找到专业人士给你张目，但是骨子里这些枪手还认同对方的观点，这打起来还是不给力啊！嘴炮输了是小事，耽误自己的推广大业可是不行的！
“那个，给维托里奥库尼伯蒂男爵立即发电报，让他立即按照我们的要求写一篇文章！报酬另付，不算在年薪之中！”鲁普雷希特叫来自己的小弟开始布置工作，事情已经发酵的差不多了，该出杀手锏了，顺便，也看看这个战友的斤两，到底值不值得自己继续投本钱！
维托里奥库尼伯蒂！近代穿越者造船必选之人啊！出生于小国之中，一款巡洋舰卖出了2位数！在4个国家海军中服役！如此NB的战绩就问你你服不服？托前世互联网的福，同时也感谢某个创立了加里波第神教的网上著名海军爱好者。穿越者知道了当今世界上还有一个未来声威大震而现在并不怎么有名的海军设计师！有如此人才，而且还在他没有发迹的时候遇上，那自然是要挖出来的！
而且更让人感到震惊的是，这哥们在1900年的时候就提出过全重炮战舰的想法！其思路之超前，脑洞之大让人不得不说声佩服！（这个出自某个杂志，有兴趣的书友可以在百度上搜搜《地中海的骏马—意大利海军无畏舰》）而更为可怕的是，这哥们在前无畏时代混的风生水起之后，当其它同时代的设计师逐渐江郎才尽，前浪被后浪推死在沙滩上的时候，伟大的意大利设计师越战越勇，亲自操刀了意大利第一级无畏舰但丁级战列舰的设计工作！
三联装炮塔，4炮塔中轴布置！侧舷最大火力12门12寸重炮！设计航速将近23节，最大试航甚至跑出过24节！要是论逼格的话，1909年开工的战舰哪个能超过它？？论火炮布局和设计，德国人几乎所有的战舰都要甘拜下风！当然，受到资金和吨位的限制，但丁的战斗力只能用一般来形容。但是毕竟在设计理念方面还是十分了得的。
“给我赚100万英镑！我让你成为一个有封地的伯爵！”当王子的小弟带着王长孙的亲笔信函送到这位目前还只能算是默默无闻的意大利设计师手中的时候，这名意大利海军未来的设计师兼财神爷仿佛被一个巨大的大蛋糕砸晕了一般！整个欧洲第一流的贵族，最有实权的王室家族之一的嫡脉长子，以每年保底年薪6万马克的年薪雇佣自己。要知道，德国首相从政府那里获得的年薪也不过5。2万马克！（当然，人家有其它收入）在一瞬间，初出茅庐的意大利设计师真找不出一个拒绝的借口！
当巴伐利亚王室代表将一张价值2万马克的支票和男爵的封诰直接拍到他的桌面上的时候，头脑有些充血的设计师立即表示会在最短的时间里交割完在意大利的一切事情然后前往德国！前后不过1个月的时间，在巨大的金钱和背景威力下。王子殿下如愿以偿！
面对自己手下最有潜力的员工，以及拿钱最多的员工。经过几次接触后，王子发现这个钱绝对没白花！这位意大利设计师不但主技能——造船十分精通，同时对营销学、人际关系等等也是十分了得！一个意大利人不但很快的和从其它地方招来的德国同僚打成一片火热，同时在销售方面的一些建议也让彭毅大开眼界！大呼这个钱没白花啊！自己后续的炒作有不少就是按照他的建议制定的！而现在，火候到了，该上大杀器了！
“是时候让那些冥顽不化的家伙接受先进设计思想的洗礼了！”在鲁普雷希特给黑鹰之主的信中第一句话，就是这样写的！“我们不但要在报纸上击败对手，还要以此为机会彻底改变德国海军的现状！所有技术和设计方面的事情都可以交给我处理，就看你能不能搞定德国海军部的事情了，事成之后，我们设计的利润可以三七开！我七你三！”
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢帝国的崛起请大家
content_en:
As the saying goes, the prince is really not a shipbuilder. It is okay to chat with fellow enthusiasts on the Internet, but it is not okay to do it seriously. You must find a professional! But it’s not easy to find professionals. Germany’s current level of shipbuilding was unmatched before Caesar came out. Even if you find a professional to help you, but deep down these gunmen still agree with each other's point of view, the fight will still be ineffective! It's a trivial matter to lose with your talk, but it won't delay your own promotion!
"Well, send a telegram to Baron Vittorio Cuniberti immediately and ask him to write an article immediately according to our requirements! The remuneration will be paid separately and is not included in the annual salary!" Ruprecht called his younger brother to start arranging the work. The matter has almost fermented. It's time to come up with the trump card. By the way, let's take a look at this comrade's worth to see if it is worth his continued investment!
Vittorio Cuniberti! The man who modern time travelers must choose to build ships! Born in a small country, a cruiser sold for double figures! Serve in the navies of 4 countries! I ask you whether you are convinced by NB’s record? Thanks to the Internet in my previous life, and also thanks to a famous online naval enthusiast who founded the Garibaldi Cult. The time traveler knows that there is another naval designer in the world today who will be famous in the future but is not very famous now! With such a talent, and meeting him when he was not yet prosperous, it was natural to dig him out!
And what’s even more shocking is that this guy proposed the idea of ​​a fully heavy artillery battleship in 1900! His thinking is advanced and his imagination is so big that people have to admire him! (This is from a magazine. Interested book friends can search "Horses of the Mediterranean - Italian Navy Dreadnoughts" on Baidu.) What is even more frightening is that after this guy became prosperous in the pre-dreadnought era, when other designers of the same generation gradually ran out of talents and were pushed to death on the beach by the waves behind, the great Italian designer became more courageous as he fought and personally took charge of the design of Italy's first-class dreadnought, the Dante-class battleship!
Triple turret, 4 turret central axis arrangement! The maximum firepower on the side is 12 12-inch heavy guns! The design speed is nearly 23 knots, and the maximum trial speed even exceeded 24 knots! If we talk about superiority, which battleship started in 1909 can surpass it? ? In terms of artillery layout and design, almost all German warships have to be defeated! Of course, due to limitations in funds and tonnage, Dante's combat effectiveness can only be described as average. But after all, the design concept is still very impressive.
"Earn 1 million pounds for me! I will make you an earl with a fief!" When the prince's younger brother brought a letter written by Wang Changsun to the hands of this currently unknown Italian designer, the future designer of the Italian Navy and the God of Wealth seemed to be knocked unconscious by a huge cake! The first-class nobleman in Europe, the eldest son of one of the most powerful royal families, hired himself with a guaranteed annual salary of 60,000 marks. You know, the annual salary the German Prime Minister receives from the government is only 52,000 marks! (Of course, he has other income) In an instant, the fledgling Italian designer really couldn’t find an excuse to refuse!
When the representative of the Bavarian royal family slapped a check worth 20,000 marks and the title of baron directly on his desk, the somewhat congested designer immediately said that he would finish everything in Italy in the shortest possible time and then go to Germany! It only took one month, with huge money and background power. His Highness the Prince got his wish!
Face your employees with the most potential and the employees who make the most money. After several contacts, the prince discovered that the money was definitely not wasted! Not only does this Italian designerThe main skill - shipbuilding is very proficient, and he is also very good at marketing, interpersonal relationships, etc.! Not only did an Italian quickly get along with his German colleagues recruited from other places, but he also gave Peng Yi some suggestions on sales that were eye-opening! He shouted that the money was not wasted! A lot of my subsequent hype was based on his suggestions! But now, the heat has arrived, and it’s time to use the killer weapon!
"It's time for those stubborn guys to accept the baptism of advanced design ideas!" This is the first sentence in Ruprecht's letter to the Lord of the Black Hawk! "Not only do we want to defeat our opponents in the newspaper, but we also want to use this as an opportunity to completely change the status quo of the German Navy! All technical and design matters can be left to me. It depends on whether you can handle the affairs of the German Navy. After that, the profit from our design can be divided into 30% and 70%! 70% for me and 30% for you!"
